value:
(to: "submitted" | "reviewed" | "approved") =>
    run(
      () => transitionInspectionApproval({ id, to }),
      (arrived) =>
        to !== "approved" && arrived === "approved"
          ? `${to === "submitted" ? "상신했습니다." : "검토를 마쳤습니다."} 결재가 끝났습니다.`
          : to === "submitted"
            ? "상신했습니다."
            : to === "reviewed"
              ? "검토를 마쳤습니다."
              : "승인했습니다.",
    )
